$comment: Default role table. The normal Flow roles select Codex. Supported steps can run a Claude candidate through the opted-in Claude CLI executor. Override whole roles in the user or repository models.json, or per run in args.models.

writer.use: Ordinary code from a finished brief

hardWriter.use: A package the lead marked hard: no reference to follow, silent failure modes, or two blocked reviews

expertWriter.use: Scoped code patch from a brief, without tools. Override explicitly for a one-off expert task.

reviewer.use: Independent code review. Never the author of the change

architect.use: Review of a plan or of a change that moves boundaries, contracts, storage or authority

applier.use: Applies an expert answer verbatim and proves every edit landed

runner.use: Runs commands and checks, returns evidence, changes no code

researcher.use: One question answered from public sources, each claim with its page

constraintChecker.use: Checks incoming constraints against recorded owner decisions.

researchExpert.use: Answers one research question with proposals, assumptions and cited facts.

factChecker.use: Checks claims against the cited lines.

acceptor.use: Select prepared acceptance scenarios and assess recorded frames

image.use: Raster images through the image model of ChatGPT

artCritic.use: Judges a picture against its brief and names one diagnosis

secondCritic.use: Second opinion on art when the first verdict is mixed or before a showing

modeller.use: Bulk procedural asset work: builds, number tuning, renders
